title: tephroseris helenitis subsp. salisburgensis
intro: Tephroseris helenitis subsp. salisburgensis, commonly known as the Alpine Saw-wort, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tephroseris helenitis subsp. salisburgensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and show potential in treating conditions like cancer. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
